units.source_text: 葛城山的神仙在葛城山与金峰山之间架石桥，他宣誓一夜竣工，结果并未完成。

en.t: An immortal of Mount Katsuragi built a stone bridge between Mount Katsuragi and Mount Kinpu, vowing to finish it in a single night, but in the end it was never completed.

units.source_text: 后人戏称桥或架桥者为葛城神仙。

en.t: Later people jokingly called the bridge, or the one who built it, the Katsuragi immortal.
